intro.text: An Elendel criminal who walked free because the arresting captain didn't know the law well enough.

items.text: Captain Reddi of the Fourth Octant arrested Daughnin, but they escaped conviction because Reddi was shaky on the law. A month after their release, Claude Aradel pointed to the case to show why Marasi's background in the solicitors' office made her an asset to the constables.
